Punch Machine • Teacher Controlled IN / OUT Timing • Present / Absent • A4 Reports

NOT SET

Punch Machine Timing

Set once. This IN / OUT timing remains active every day until you change it.

Today:
Punch rule: Sunday is always Non-Working. Saved timing stays active Monday–Saturday until you change it. A custom Holiday can be set below. Sunday / Holiday never reduces student attendance percentage.

Sunday & Holiday Control

Sunday is automatic. For other holidays, choose From and To date. If the range contains Sunday, it remains shown as Sunday.

SUNDAY • NON-WORKING
Select Batch / Class above to manage holidays.

Manual Student Punch

Teacher can enter a student's IN or OUT punch at any date/time. Punch-machine timing limits do not apply here.

Select batch, student and date/time, then choose IN or OUT.

⚡ Smart Manual Attendance

Bulk teacher-authorized correction. Assigned times are estimated manual times, not recorded machine punch times.

Load your batch
Load students. Save only verified teacher corrections.

Daily Student Attendance
